chapter_note: A short, heavily damaged chapter (72.7% damage) that preserves a clear substrate teaching: the emanation of Five Fathers from the Five Limbs/Members (mental faculties) of the Father of Greatness. The mapping is purely internal — mind→Beloved of Lights, life→Mother of Life, teaching→Beloved, counsel→Virgin of Light, reflection→[Fifth] — exactly the kind of degree-by-degree correspondential structure characteristic of the oldest layer. Only the opening framing formula (i=3) and the embedded "ⲡⲁⲭⲉ" attribution in i=4 are dialogue frame. Editorial fatigue score is negative because the dialogue frame is concentrated at the opening and the substrate teaching dominates the body.
